quote: > - Every panic after init step 4 produces exactly one single-line structured record in its home-level role file: location, thread, role and instance, except the bounded exemptions listed in Section 10; the payload and the backtrace are written only to the instance-scoped detail file (Section 7).

moves.claim: The panic hook stays each process's first step and writes one line only where a role file is open; the chunk moves the strict-modes check ahead of that open, so the plan states that a refused check falls in the pre-file window and no new check path ends a role through an uncaught unwind.

quote: > NEVER create `~/.viola/`, `--home` or any file under it with the default umask. Directories are 0700 and files 0600 (`OpenOptionsExt::mode`); the only exception is the pinned `bin/<version>-<hash>/viola` at 0700, and NEVER make it group- or world-writable. On Windows, NEVER accept a `--home` outside `%USERPROFILE%` without an explicit protected user + SYSTEM DACL, and NEVER skip the Windows owner + DACL strict-modes check at startup (`#[cfg(windows)]` must not return `Ok(())` unchecked), and NEVER pass a NULL DACL, a volume without persistent ACLs, or an inherit-only `GENERIC_*` grant just because no specific-rights ACE matched.

moves.claim: The owner-only creation and the Windows strict-modes check the chunk makes whole must never fall back to the umask or let a `#[cfg(windows)]` arm pass unchecked.

quote: > NEVER run `statusline_command` from a `snapshot.json` whose home or instance directory fails the strict-modes check. Write access there equals code execution.

moves.claim: The hook's new pre-read check is what keeps `statusline_command` from running out of a home or instance directory that fails strict-modes.

quote: > NEVER reuse an existing `bin/<version>-<hash>/viola(.exe)` without re-hashing it (SHA-256, truncated) against `<hash>`, NEVER derive `<hash>` from a non-cryptographic hash (FNV, `DefaultHasher`), and NEVER reuse existing `plugin/` files without rewriting them. NEVER load or launch a `bin/<version>-<hash>/conpty/` companion without its full SHA-256 re-hash against the compiled pin through a `FILE_SHARE_READ`-only handle held until the spawn, and NEVER overwrite or delete a companion that fails it (left as found; the child runs on the inbox ConPTY).

moves.claim: The pinned-binary re-hash, the per-start plugin rewrite and the ConPTY companions' re-hash are the chunk's own work, and the `pin_exe` fix must keep each.

quote: > NEVER write to stderr from `viola hook`, and NEVER exit non-zero from it, including on security-check failures.

moves.claim: A refused strict-modes check in `viola hook` must still write nothing to stderr and exit 0.

quote: > NEVER create `diagnostics/` files readable by other users.

moves.claim: The DACL check before any `diagnostics/` file is opened is what keeps those files unreadable by other users.
